title: PublicationReceipt
description: Forge state + operations performed (ADR-0016 §3, ADR-0017 §7 Reconcile): records what was actually written to the forge (thread/approval/merge, target ids, timestamps) for reconciliation/debugging. Nested operation shapes stay closed (no secrets, raw policy, or user-controlled Markdown). Top-level additionalProperties are allowed (ADR-0017 §9 additive-tolerant reports).

operations.description: Named collection keyed by targetId — mandatory unique ID; source order carries no meaning without an explicit priority (ADR-0017 §9).

targetId.description: Forge-assigned id of the thread/approval/merge operation performed.
